name: Exp_3XMA_Ishimoku
summary: This EA uses a triple smoothed moving average system based on the Ishimoku concept, comparing a central XMA line against upper and lower envelope lines derived from high/low price smoothing. It generates buy signals when the XMA crosses above the envelope ceiling and sell signals when it crosses below the floor, with configurable smoothing methods and multi-timeframe support.
summary_zh: 该EA基于石毛概念的三重平滑移动平均系统，将中央XMA线与由高低价平滑得出的上下包络线进行比较。当XMA上穿包络上限时产生买入信号，下穿包络下限时产生卖出信号，支持可配置平滑算法和多时间框架。
strategy_analysis: 策略核心是基于三重平滑移动平均的石毛趋势跟踪系统。入场条件：当XMA值从下方突破上下包络线的最大值时触发买入信号，当XMA值从上方跌破上下包络线的最小值时触发卖出信号。出场条件：通过独立的买卖平仓权限控制，买入信号同时触发空头平仓，卖出信号同时触发多头平仓。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于存款比例的资金管理参数MM，负值代表固定手数大小。止损止盈采用固定点数方式，分别为1000点和2000点。策略使用三个不同周期的XMA（8/25/80）构建多层次的平滑体系，支持SMA、EMA、JJMA、JurX等多种平滑算法。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy is centered on a triple smoothed moving average Ishimoku-style trend following system. Entry conditions: a buy signal is triggered when the XMA value crosses above the maximum of the upper and lower envelope lines from below, and a sell signal is triggered when the XMA crosses below the minimum of the envelope lines from above. Exit conditions are handled through independent buy/sell close permissions, where a buy signal simultaneously closes short positions and a sell signal simultaneously closes long positions. Position sizing uses the MM parameter which can represent either a deposit share or a fixed lot size when negative. Stop loss and take profit use fixed point values of 1000 and 2000 points respectively. The strategy employs three XMA layers with different smoothing depths (8/25/80) to build a multi-level smoothing hierarchy, supporting various smoothing algorithms including SMA, EMA, JJMA, and JurX.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 存款份额或固定手数（负值为固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Deposit percentage or fixed lot; negative value = lot size

parameters.name: Deviation_
parameters.description: 最大价格偏差点数（滑点容忍度）

parameters.name: XPhase
parameters.description: 平滑参数（JJMA范围-100~+100，VIDIA为CMO周期，AMA为慢MA周期）
parameters.description_en: Smoothing param; JJMA: -100 to +100, VIDYA: CMO period, AMA: slow MA period

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 获取入场信号的K线索引

pros: 三重平滑体系（8/25/80周期）提供多层次的噪音过滤，信号更加可靠
支持多种平滑算法（SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX等），灵活度高，可适应不同市场环境
独立的买卖开仓和平仓权限控制，可以单独启用或禁用每个方向的操作
有新K线检测机制，避免同一根K线内重复交易
止损止盈参数齐全，具备基本的风险控制框架
pros_en: Triple smoothing system (8/25/80 periods) provides multi-level noise filtering for more reliable signals
Supports multiple smoothing algorithms (SMA/EMA/JJMA/JurX etc.) offering high flexibility for different market conditions
Independent buy/sell open and close permission controls allow granular enabling or disabling of each direction
New bar detection mechanism prevents repeated trading within the same bar
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters provide a basic risk control framework
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点的固定值过大，在多数品种上可能导致不必要的风险敞口
缺乏点差过滤和交易时间过滤，在点差较大或流动性差的市场时段可能产生不利成交
没有持仓数量检查，可能重复开仓导致仓位过大
MM参数为负值时表示固定手数的设计不够直观，容易误用
依赖外部自定义指标3XMA_Ishimoku，如果该指标未正确安装则EA无法运行且仅打印日志而非停止初始化
cons_en: Fixed stop loss of 1000 points and take profit of 2000 points are excessively large for most instruments, potentially leading to unnecessary risk exposure
Lacks spread filter and trading session filter, which may cause unfavorable fills during high-spread or low-liquidity periods
No position count check, potentially leading to repeated position opening and oversized exposure
The MM parameter design where negative values mean fixed lot size is unintuitive and prone to misuse
Depends on external custom indicator 3XMA_Ishimoku; if not properly installed, the EA fails silently with only a print log instead of stopping initialization
improvements: 增加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在不利条件下开仓
添加最大持仓数量限制和资金管理优化，防止过度集中仓位
将指标句柄获取失败时返回INIT_FAILED而非继续运行，并增加更完善的错误处理机制
improvements_en: Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid opening positions under unfavorable conditions
Add maximum position count limits and money management optimization to prevent over-concentration of positions
Return INIT_FAILED when indicator handle acquisition fails instead of continuing to run, and implement more robust error handling

risk_points: 指标句柄获取失败时EA仍继续运行，OnTick中所有CopyBuffer调用将失败并导致持续Recount
没有最大持仓数量检查，理论上可以在每个新信号上无限开仓
固定止损止盈点数不考虑品种波动率差异，可能对某些品种不适合
MM参数负值表示固定手数的语义不直观，用户可能误设为过大手数
risk_points_en: EA continues running when indicator handle acquisition fails, all CopyBuffer calls in OnTick will fail causing persistent Recount loops
No maximum position count check, theoretically allowing unlimited position opening on each new signal
Fixed stop loss/take profit points do not account for instrument volatility differences, potentially unsuitable for some instruments
The negative-value-means-fixed-lot semantics of MM parameter is unintuitive, users may accidentally set excessively large lot sizes
